summary: Iteration 3 — Validated new 'Últimos 50 SKUs' tab, enrich-worker lifecycle, raw_description persistence, recent-skus aggregation, sigla mapping for variations. 18/19 pytest tests pass. One HIGH-priority bug found: GET /api/bling/recent-skus?limit=50 (the DEFAULT call when user opens /bling-lote) consistently returns 502 after ~60s ingress timeout because list_recent_skus() performs ~100 sequential Bling HTTP calls (1×/produtos?codigo=X and 1×/produtos/{id} per SKU). Frontend renders correctly (all 4 tabs, default = recent, pagination hidden on recent), but the Últimos 50 list is stuck in 'Carregando...' until the request fails. Re-enrichment flow itself was not exercised end-to-end (would burn LLM credits + mutate live Bling catalog); the bulk-enrich POST contract is unchanged from iter 2.

critical.issue: Times out at ingress (60s → 502 Bad Gateway). bulk_enrichment.list_recent_skus() loops sequentially over up to 50 SKUs, doing 2 Bling REST calls per SKU (codigo search + full fetch). Total wall time exceeds 60s even on a warm Bling. Frontend defaults to filtro='recent' and uses limit=50, so users land on a page that never finishes loading. Reproduce: curl --max-time 90 https://bling-product-robot.preview.emergentagent.com/api/bling/recent-skus?limit=50 → HTTP 502 at ~60.1s. With limit=5 or 10 it completes in <5s. Fix options: (a) parallelize the per-SKU hydration with asyncio.gather (bounded semaphore 5-10); (b) cache last-known enriched/marca/preco on enrich_pending docs and skip Bling round-trip when fresh; (c) drop the codigo search and resolve product_id from product_raw/enrich_pending directly when available; (d) reduce default frontend limit to 20.

minor.issue: The codigo-search step is wasteful when entry.get('product_id') is already known from enrich_pending — we could go straight to _fetch_full(product_id) and skip GET /produtos?codigo=X for ~half the SKUs.

No DELETE endpoint to clean up TEST raw_description rows. The test seeded TEST_RAWDESC_001 and TEST_RAWDESC_PYTEST_001 — they will persist in product_raw forever and show up as 'recent' SKUs (with bling_found=false because no Bling match).
Still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — flagged in iter 1 and still not migrated to FastAPI lifespan handlers.

Loop `for k, v in _SIGLA_MAP.items(): if clean.startswith(k) or clean.endswith(k)` runs in dict-insertion order — for 'pp' it correctly matches 'pp' before 'p' only because 'pp' is inserted after 'p'. Fragile if map is reordered. Consider sorting keys by len desc, or doing exact-match-only and falling back.

ui_bugs.issue: Default view stuck on 'Carregando...' because backend /bling/recent-skus?limit=50 times out at 60s with 502. After failure the table silently shows '0 produtos nesta página'. No error banner is rendered to the user.

When recent-skus call fails (502/timeout) the catch sets produtos=[] but does NOT surface an error toast/message. User just sees 'Carregando...' replaced by an empty table with no indication the call failed.

integration_issues.issue: Loading spinner runs ~60s then resolves to empty list (because of the backend 502). Has to be the FIRST thing fixed since it's the page's default view.

action_items: HIGH: Parallelize the Bling hydration loop in bulk_enrichment.list_recent_skus() with asyncio.gather (bounded semaphore ~5-10) so that 50 SKUs resolve in <10s instead of >60s. This single change fixes both the 502 and the 'Carregando...' UX bug.

HIGH: Add an error state to BlingBulkEnrich.loadProducts — when the recent-skus call throws, show a red banner 'Falha ao carregar últimos SKUs — tente novamente' so the empty table isn't silently misleading.
MEDIUM: When entry['product_id'] is already known from enrich_pending, skip the /produtos?codigo= lookup and go straight to _fetch_full(pid).
LOW: Migrate FastAPI startup hook from @app.on_event to lifespan context manager (carried over from iter 1).
critical_code_review_comments: list_recent_skus performs N sequential Bling REST calls in an async function — classic anti-pattern when asyncio.gather + a small semaphore would cut wall time 10x. Same module already does similar work in list_products_with_status; consider extracting a hydrate_one(sku) helper and reusing it.

Frontend useCallback dependency list for loadProducts includes [pagina, filtro, busca] — when filtro==='recent' it ignores pagina/busca but still re-runs on those changes. Minor wasted requests; consider conditional dependency.
BlingBulkEnrich.loadProducts has no AbortController — if user switches tabs while limit=50 is in-flight, the late response still mutates state. Use an AbortSignal to cancel previous request.

POST /api/bling/raw-description accepts arbitrary SKU and stores raw_description with source='manual' but does NOT validate the SKU exists in Bling. A typo creates a phantom product_raw doc that then pollutes the 'Últimos 50' view as bling_found=false.

enrich_worker.start_worker is correctly idempotent (checks task.done()) — good. _WORKER_STATE['running'] flag is set inside _loop, so there is a brief window between asyncio.create_task and the first line of _loop where /enrich/queue would report running=false; not observed in practice but worth a comment.

rca of the issue: HIGH 502 on /api/bling/recent-skus?limit=50 — RCA: bulk_enrichment.list_recent_skus() (lines 245-340) builds a list of up to 50 SKUs from enrich_pending + product_raw, then enters a sequential `for entry in ordered:` loop where each iteration does TWO awaits against Bling: (1) `bling_service.bling_request('GET','/produtos', params={'codigo': sku, 'limite': 5})` to resolve the product id, then (2) `_fetch_full(target['id'])` (another GET /produtos/{id}). At ~0.6-1.2s per Bling call, 50 × 2 = 100 sequential awaits ≈ 60-120s — exceeds the 60s ingress timeout and the request is killed mid-flight with HTTP 502. Frontend useEffect fires this on mount (default filtro='recent'), so users see 'Carregando...' until the timeout, then an empty table with no error message. Mitigation: wrap the per-entry hydration in an inner async function `async def _hydrate(entry): ...` and run via `await asyncio.gather(*[asyncio.create_task(_hydrate(e)) for e in ordered])` — or better, use a Semaphore(8) to cap Bling concurrency at 8 parallel requests (Bling API rate limits are ~10 req/s per account). Expected wall time after fix: ~6-8s for 50 SKUs.
